However, if they do so and the eliminated Herald receives under 70% of the total votes, they must sacrifice Amica. Amica can only be revived if Ludus sacrifices their ability to vote at future elimination. ' Once per game, Ludus may choose to randomly shuffle around the Patrons of every Herald for one round. If a Herald uses an ability of their new Patron that round, one random ability from their old Patron will be unusable for the next two rounds when their old Patron returns. This applies to everyone except for Ludus. Before using this ability, Ludus may create a list of three Patrons for themself. They will be randomly given one of these three.
